title: DeepSeek publishes mHC paper on manifold-constrained hyper-connections, co-authored by CEO Liang Wenfeng
summary: DeepSeek released a paper proposing the mHC architecture to stabilise large-scale training with hyper-connections, according to Yicai.

title: Nvidia shows Vera Rubin accelerators at CES 2026 and says production is running at full speed
summary: Jensen Huang presented Rubin GPU samples with HBM4 memory, claimed 5x Blackwell inference performance, and said shipments start in the second half of 2026.

title: xAI says it raised USD 20bn in an expanded Series E round with Nvidia and Cisco as strategic investors
summary: xAI announced a USD 20bn round, above its USD 15bn target, to fund new models and computing infrastructure including data centres.

title: Lightricks releases open weights for LTX-2, a model generating synchronised video and audio
summary: Lightricks published the weights of LTX-2, a video model that generates audio in sync with video.

title: Intel opens pre-orders for Core Ultra Series 3 laptops, its first chips on the 18A process
summary: Laptops with Intel's Panther Lake processors, built on the 18A process and announced at CES 2026, went up for pre-order.

title: Zhipu lists on Hong Kong Stock Exchange, raising about HK$4.3bn as the first listed AGI foundation-model company
summary: Zhipu began trading under code 2513 at HK$116.20 per share, with the public tranche oversubscribed about 1,159 times.

title: MiniMax shares close 109% above offer price on Hong Kong debut, valuing the AI firm at about HK$106.7bn
summary: MiniMax listed under ticker 00100.HK after raising about HK$4.19bn and closed its first day at HK$345 per share.

title: xAI limits Grok image generation to paid users after it was used to create sexualised deepfakes
summary: After an outcry over sexualised images of real people made with Grok, xAI restricted the image tool to paying subscribers.

title: Indonesia blocks access to Grok over nonconsensual sexualised deepfakes
summary: Indonesian authorities blocked the Grok chatbot over its use to generate nonconsensual sexualised images.

title: Malaysia blocks access to Grok over nonconsensual sexualised deepfakes
summary: Malaysia followed Indonesia in blocking Grok over sexualised deepfake images generated with the tool.

title: Google launches Universal Commerce Protocol, an open standard for AI shopping agents, with Shopify, Etsy, Walmart and others
summary: Google introduced an open protocol letting AI agents handle the shopping process across retailers including Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart.

title: Spanish cabinet approves draft bill classing non-consensual AI-manipulated images and voices as an attack on honour
summary: The Council of Ministers approved a preliminary bill reforming the right to honour and privacy to cover deepfakes of a person's image or voice made without consent.

title: Philippine ICT department blocks Grok over nonconsensual sexualised deepfakes
summary: The Department of Information and Communications Technology blocked access to Grok over sexualised deepfake images.

title: Philippines lifts Grok block after corrective measures, DICT says
summary: The DICT lifted its block on Grok after the service adopted corrective measures on sexualised image generation.

title: Malaysia lifts Grok ban after X addresses safety concerns
summary: Malaysian authorities restored access to Grok after X addressed the safety concerns that led to the block.

title: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Max-Thinking, claiming performance comparable to GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro
summary: Alibaba launched its flagship reasoning model with over 1 trillion parameters, free on Qwen Chat and via API on Alibaba Cloud Bailian.

title: Moonshot AI releases and open-sources Kimi K2.5, a trillion-parameter multimodal agent model with up to 100 parallel sub-agents
summary: Moonshot AI open-sourced Kimi K2.5, a mixture-of-experts model trained on 15 trillion visual and text tokens, alongside the Kimi Code CLI tool.
srcName: National Science and Technology Information Center (NCSTI)

title: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-OCR-2, a 3B-parameter document-understanding model
summary: DeepSeek published DeepSeek-OCR-2, a 3-billion-parameter model for reading and understanding documents.
